title: ChatTS: Aligning Time Series with LLMs via Synthetic Data for Enhanced Understanding and Reasoning

claim.summary: ChatTS aligns patched time series with language using synthetic attribute-rich sequences and evolved QAs, retaining numeric scale/offset in its prompts.

modules.name: Context-aware patch-to-language alignment
modules.scope_reason: A trained temporal MLP encoder and multimodal alignment adapt the language model to numerical series.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; 3.4.1 Context-Aware Time-Series Multimodal LLM

modules.name: Attribute-based series and TSEvol instruction generation
modules.scope_reason: Synthetic data is explicitly built to train temporal alignment and reasoning; record training-data role rather than a deployed generation service.
